title: Number bases
hints: `strconv.FormatInt` and `strconv.ParseInt` work with `int64`, so you need conversions: `int64(n)` going in, `int(v)` coming out.
`v, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, base, 64)`; if `err != nil`, return `0, err`. Otherwise return `int(v), nil`.
`fmt.Sprintf("%[1]d = 0b%[1]b = 0o%[1]o = 0x%[1]X", n)` reuses the first argument for every verb.
